{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Re-load the data to ensure clean state
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Inspect the revenue column to see the format
print(sales_df['revenue'].head(10))

# Clean the revenue column: remove $ and commas, then convert to float
sales_df['revenue_clean'] = sales_df['revenue'].str.replace('$', '', regex=False)
sales_df['revenue_clean'] = sales_df['revenue_clean'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False)
sales_df['revenue_clean'] = pd.to_numeric(sales_df['revenue_clean'], errors='coerce')

# Check for any invalid conversions
print("Invalid revenue entries (should be 0 if none):", sales_df['revenue_clean'].isnull().sum())

# Confirm the new column is numeric
type(sales_df['revenue_clean'].dtype)"}
